title: the proof standard's classes and its written conclusion
line: a household's census and a birth register read by data/evidence-classes.csv: the census a derivative whose birth is secondary information and indirect evidence (an age worked into a year), its residence primary, its parents a relationship FamilySearch computed; the birth register's own birth primary and direct, each record named by the original it was copied from; tools/proof.py writes the conclusion per key fact: the father's sex meets the standard, his birth owes an argument while its birthplace conflict is open (printed with its question id and the rule's own reading of it: the register states the birth first-hand, but its place is not yet resolved, so the rule would not decide it yet), his son's parents owe one on secondary information alone, the census stating him the head's son, and his wife's marriage stated by her obituary (read as an obituary through the index it is filed under) beside the census's computed one still owes one on secondary information; the birthplace conflict closed by the owner with a written reason leaves only the research
